```{r}
{
  library(tidyverse)

  returns_tibble <- raw_SEP %>%
    drop_na() %>%
    filter(date >= min(date)) %>%
    arrange(date, ticker) %>%
    as_tibble() %>%
    group_by(date)

  num_tickers_per_date <- returns_tibble %>%
    summarise(n_distinct(ticker))

  length(unique(returns_tibble$date))

  returns_tibble <- returns_tibble %>%
    ungroup()

  returns_tibble <- returns_tibble %>%
    group_by(ticker) %>%
    filter(n() == 2599)

  length(unique(returns_tibble$ticker))

  returns_tibble <- returns_tibble %>%
    mutate(lag_adj_close = lag(closeadj)) %>%
    drop_na()

  returns_tibble <- returns_tibble %>%
    mutate(log_return = log(closeadj / lag_adj_close))

  returns_tibble <- returns_tibble %>%
    select(date, ticker, log_return)

  returns_tibble <- returns_tibble %>%
    pivot_wider(id_cols = ticker,
                names_from = date,
                values_from = log_return)
}
```

```{r}
  other_tibble <- raw_SF1 %>%

  # Separate into the six reporting dimensions

  other_tibble_ART <- other_tibble %>% filter(dimension == "ART")
  other_tibble_ARY <- other_tibble %>% filter(dimension == "ARY")
  other_tibble_MRQ <- other_tibble %>% filter(dimension == "MRQ")
  other_tibble_MRT <- other_tibble %>% filter(dimension == "MRT")
  other_tibble_MRY <- other_tibble %>% filter(dimension == "MRY")

  # Compare overlap with returns_tibble
  length(intersect(unique(returns_tibble$ticker), unique(other_tibble_ARQ$ticker)))
  length(intersect(unique(returns_tibble$ticker), unique(other_tibble_ART$ticker)))
  length(intersect(unique(returns_tibble$ticker), unique(other_tibble_ARY$ticker)))
  length(intersect(unique(returns_tibble$ticker), unique(other_tibble_MRQ$ticker)))
  length(intersect(unique(returns_tibble$ticker), unique(other_tibble_MRT$ticker)))
  length(intersect(unique(returns_tibble$ticker), unique(other_tibble_MRY$ticker)))

  rm(other_tibble_ARQ,
     other_tibble_ART,
     other_tibble_ARY,
     other_tibble_MRQ,
     other_tibble_MRY)

  # Keep only tickers in returns_tibble
  vector_of_returns_tibble_tickers <- as.vector(returns_tibble$ticker)

  other_tibble_MRT <- other_tibble_MRT %>%
    filter(ticker %in% vector_of_returns_tibble_tickers)

  # Keep only the newest financial statement
  other_tibble_MRT <- other_tibble_MRT %>%
    group_by(ticker) %>%
    filter(calendardate == max(calendardate))

  # Keep only recent reports
  other_tibble_MRT <- other_tibble_MRT %>%
    filter(calendardate > "2024-12-30")

  other_tibble_MRT <- other_tibble_MRT %>%
    drop_na() %>%
    ungroup()

  # Create financial ratios
  other_tibble_MRT <- other_tibble_MRT %>%
    mutate(
      rel_assetsc       = assetsc/assetsavg,
      rel_debtc         = debtc/debt,
      rel_inventory     = inventory/assets,
      rel_investments   = investments/assets,
      rel_investmentsc  = investmentsc/investments,
      rel_ncfo          = ncfo/ncf,
      rel_payables      = payables/liabilities,
      rel_ppnenett      = ppnenet/assets,
      rel_receivables   = receivables/assets,
      rel_retearn       = retearn/equity,
      rel_rnd           = rnd/revenue,
      rel_sgna          = sgna/revenue,
      rel_tangibles     = tangibles/assets
    )

  # Keep only selected variables
  other_tibble_MRT <- other_tibble_MRT %>%
    select(
      ticker,
      assetsavg,
      rel_assetsc,
      assetturnover,
      bvps,
      capex,
      cashnequsd,
      currentratio,
      de,
      rel_debtc,
      divyield,
      ebitdamargin,
      evebitda,
      grossmargin,
      rel_inventory,
      rel_investments,
      rel_investmentsc,
      marketcap,
      rel_ncfo,
      netmargin,
      rel_payables,
      payoutratio,
      pb,
      pe,
      rel_ppnenett,
      ps,
      rel_receivables,
      rel_retearn,
      rel_rnd,
      roa,
      roe,
      roic,
      rel_sgna,
      rel_tangibles,
      cor,
      fcfps
    )

  tickers_temp_home <- as.vector(other_tibble_MRT$ticker)

  all.equal(tickers_temp_home, other_tibble_MRT$ticker)

  other_tibble_MRT <- other_tibble_MRT %>%
    select(-ticker)

  # Standardize
  scaled_other_tibble_MRT <- scale(other_tibble_MRT)

  scaled_other_tibble_MRT <- as_tibble(scaled_other_tibble_MRT)

  SF1_tibble <- scaled_other_tibble_MRT %>%
    mutate(ticker = tickers_temp_home)

  unscaled_SF1_tibble <- other_tibble_MRT
}
```

```{r}
library(tidyverse)

# Define target tickers
target_tickers <- c("AAPL", "GOOGL", "BLK", "AXP", "BAC", 
                    "CI", "JNJ", "MDT", "BA", "MMM", "FDX")

# ==============================================================================
# 1. PROCESS DAILY RETURNS (SEP) - Filtered to 11 stocks
# ==============================================================================
returns_clean <- raw_SEP %>%
  filter(ticker %in% target_tickers) %>%  # <--- FILTER ADDED HERE
  select(ticker, date, closeadj) %>%
  mutate(date = as.Date(date)) %>%
  group_by(ticker) %>%
  arrange(date, .by_group = TRUE) %>%
  mutate(
    lag_adj_close = lag(closeadj),
    log_return    = log(closeadj / lag_adj_close)
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  drop_na(log_return) %>%
  select(ticker, date, log_return)

# Pivot returns into Wide Matrix Format
returns_wide <- returns_clean %>%
  pivot_wider(
    id_cols     = ticker,
    names_from  = date,
    values_from = log_return
  ) %>%
  mutate(across(-ticker, ~ replace_na(., 0)))

# ==============================================================================
# 2. PROCESS FINANCIAL STATEMENT METRICS (SF1) - Filtered to 11 stocks
# ==============================================================================
sf1_mrt <- raw_SF1 %>%
  filter(
    dimension == "MRT",
    ticker %in% target_tickers            # <--- FILTER ADDED HERE
  ) %>%
  mutate(calendardate = as.Date(calendardate)) %>%
  group_by(ticker) %>%
  filter(calendardate == max(calendardate)) %>%
  ungroup()

# Compute Ratios safely
sf1_ratios <- sf1_mrt %>%
  transmute(
    ticker,
    assetsavg,
    rel_assetsc     = if_else(assetsavg == 0 | is.na(assetsavg), 0, assetsc / assetsavg),
    assetturnover   = replace_na(assetturnover, 0),
    bvps            = replace_na(bvps, 0),
    capex           = replace_na(capex, 0),
    cashnequsd      = replace_na(cashnequsd, 0),
    currentratio    = replace_na(currentratio, 0),
    de              = replace_na(de, 0),
    divyield        = replace_na(divyield, 0),
    ebitdamargin    = replace_na(ebitdamargin, 0),
    evebitda        = replace_na(evebitda, 0),
    grossmargin     = replace_na(grossmargin, 0),
    rel_inventory   = if_else(assets == 0 | is.na(assets), 0, replace_na(inventory, 0) / assets),
    rel_investments = if_else(assets == 0 | is.na(assets), 0, replace_na(investments, 0) / assets),
    marketcap       = replace_na(marketcap, 0),
    netmargin       = replace_na(netmargin, 0),
    rel_payables    = if_else(liabilities == 0 | is.na(liabilities), 0, replace_na(payables, 0) / liabilities),
    payoutratio     = replace_na(payoutratio, 0),
    pb              = replace_na(pb, 0),
    pe              = replace_na(pe, 0),
    rel_ppnenett    = if_else(assets == 0 | is.na(assets), 0, replace_na(ppnenet, 0) / assets),
    ps              = replace_na(ps, 0),
    rel_receivables = if_else(assets == 0 | is.na(assets), 0, replace_na(receivables, 0) / assets),
    rel_retearn     = if_else(equity == 0 | is.na(equity), 0, replace_na(retearn, 0) / equity),
    rel_rnd         = if_else(revenue == 0 | is.na(revenue), 0, replace_na(rnd, 0) / revenue),
    roa             = replace_na(roa, 0),
    roe             = replace_na(roe, 0),
    roic            = replace_na(roic, 0),
    rel_sgna        = if_else(revenue == 0 | is.na(revenue), 0, replace_na(sgna, 0) / revenue),
    rel_tangibles   = if_else(assets == 0 | is.na(assets), 0, replace_na(tangibles, 0) / assets),
    cor             = replace_na(cor, 0),
    fcfps           = replace_na(fcfps, 0)
  )

# ==============================================================================
# 3. ALIGN TICKERS & BUILD FINAL MATRICES
# ==============================================================================
common_tickers <- intersect(returns_wide$ticker, sf1_ratios$ticker)

returns_aligned <- returns_wide %>%
  filter(ticker %in% common_tickers) %>%
  arrange(ticker)

sf1_aligned <- sf1_ratios %>%
  filter(ticker %in% common_tickers) %>%
  arrange(ticker)

# --- Matrix 1: Scaled Financial Ratios (11 Rows) ---
sf1_numeric <- sf1_aligned %>% select(-ticker)
sf1_scaled  <- scale(sf1_numeric)
rownames(sf1_scaled) <- sf1_aligned$ticker

# --- Matrix 2: Log Returns (11 Rows) ---
returns_numeric <- returns_aligned %>% select(-ticker)
returns_matrix  <- as.matrix(returns_numeric)
rownames(returns_matrix) <- returns_aligned$ticker
   
```











```{r}
# Load psych for robust Factor Analysis
if(!require(psych)) install.packages("psych")
library(psych)

# ==============================================================================
# CHUNK 8: MODELS FOR THE 11 STOCKS
# Dataset: sf1_scaled (11 Tickers in rownames, standardized metrics in columns)
# ==============================================================================

# 1. PRINCIPAL COMPONENT ANALYSIS (PCA)
sf1_variance <- apply(sf1_numeric, 2, var, na.rm = TRUE)
sf1_valid    <- sf1_numeric[, sf1_variance > 0 & !is.na(sf1_variance)]

sf1_scaled <- scale(sf1_valid)
sf1_scaled[!is.finite(sf1_scaled)] <- 0
rownames(sf1_scaled) <- sf1_aligned$ticker

pca_result <- prcomp(sf1_scaled, center = FALSE, scale. = FALSE)


# 2. FACTOR ANALYSIS (FA - 2 Factors using Principal Axis / MinRes)
# 'psych::fa' handles near-singular matrices where base 'factanal' fails
fa_result <- fa(sf1_scaled, nfactors = 2, rotate = "varimax", fm = "minres")


# 3. HIERARCHICAL CLUSTERING (Ward's Method)
dist_matrix   <- dist(sf1_scaled, method = "euclidean")
hclust_result <- hclust(dist_matrix, method = "ward.D2")


# 4. K-MEANS CLUSTERING (K = 3)
set.seed(42)
kmeans_result <- kmeans(sf1_scaled, centers = 3, nstart = 25)

```
